thread:
zoe: FYI PR https://github.com/redwood/ruby-sdk/pull/482 adds retry/backoff parity but CI is flaky on Windows and there's a token-refresh edge-case. Anyone looked into 401 -> retry behavior?
matt: I saw the failing trace. Tests show intermittent 401 when the auth token expires mid-request (streaming case). Ruby client doesn't seem to refresh in middleware like python does.
sam: I can take a look. quick skim: the retry middleware only retries on 5xx and Faraday::ConnectionFailed, not on 401. Also auth middleware order might be wrong — retry runs before auth refresh.
anjali: Also seeing Windows CI failing on openssl cert chain for Ruby 3.2. PR currently has a temporary "openssl_verify_mode = 0" fix which we should NOT merge.
matt: Agreed on the cert thing. We should fix the root cause (CA bundle) instead of disabling verification.
sam: Plan: modify auth middleware to intercept 401, call token_refresh, then re-issue the request (with exp backoff for multiple attempts). Add unit test that simulates expired token + streaming chunk.
zoe: That would match Python behavior. Can you also add an integration test that runs a tiny stream and forces token expiry? Keep it lightweight so it doesn't blow up CI.
sam: Yep. Pseudocode I'll add:
```
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'], retry: {max: 2, backoff: ->(n){ 0.1 * (2**n) }})
# stub token expiry to return 401 on first chunk, 200 after refresh
```
matt: Once tests added, I'll review. If green, we should cherry-pick to 0.3.x branch for the imminent patch release.
anjali: On the Windows CA issue, I'll upload a minimal script to reproduce and a temp container to validate CA bundle paths.
deploy-bot: CI: re-run requested by matt — windows_build_ruby_3_2 #488 restarted
zoe: Thanks all. Action items: sam = auth middleware + tests, anjali = CA repro, matt = review + cherry-pick if green. Ping me on thread when CI passes. :thumbsup:
matt: Pinged reviewers in PR, added a small checklist in the PR description for backporting.
sam: Starting work now, will open a draft commit in the PR with tests so reviewers can iterate.
zoe: Minimal support question: if someone hits this in production, workaround is to rotate API key (force new token) and toggle to Dedicated routing. We'll add a short note to the SDK troubleshooting docs once fix is merged.
anjali: Ok, I'm attaching the CA repro gist in the PR comments.
zoe: Great. Closing the loop: update thread when PR changes state. Thanks!
